procedure: EA-NEGONT-02 v0.7 §3.4 D/R/O (working; not frozen). Admission by reading: a candidate is admitted to a stratum when its sentence or paragraph makes a claim of that stratum's kind: D, a claim on what machine-learning classifiers at accelerators and colliders do, how they are validated, or what their deployment forecloses or preserves; R, a relation between that field and an archive object (the Zenodo termination, the cross-domain homology, the archive's own entity model); O, an archive category applied to it (classifier foreclosure, Claim A/Claim B, OAR/BAR/IAI, auditable foreclosure, the endogenous sophon, the irreversibility frontier, baseline capture, open-set assimilation). Naming the LHC is not enough. Machine compositions quoted in deposits are reception evidence and are not admitted. Volume is never a ground of removal; versions of one work are kept as instances of a lineage.

verdicts.reason: The defining deposit of the v1 row lhc-trigger-foreclosure (source_deposit 932), read whole with its three appended witnesses (W1 mechanisms, W2 delusions, W3 empirical accounting). D: the convergent claim (§2), Claim A (foreclosure structurally present in every classifier-mediated LHC trigger, marked defensible and empirically grounded) and Claim B (recursive collapse has occurred, marked stronger and not empirically established), the corrected formulation, the formal findings incl. the deployed score forms and Finke as counterexample, the falsification section. O: classifier collapse (W1), foreclosure mechanisms, the delusion catalogue as hypotheses for audit, synthesis-overreach. R: the cross-domain homology (stated as hypothesis) and the Wound Gauge/Zenodo relation. W2's 'It is here. It is operating.' is ledgered as contested within the pool; the synthesis grades it.

The operative paper (OAR Protocol v0.3), read whole. D: model-independence vs signal-template agnosticism for AXOL1TL, CICADA, GELATO; what the literature establishes (§1.2) and does not (§1.3); score-by-score analysis (§2); Finke placed as counterexample only. O: OAR, BAR, IAI with the no-bounds discipline; three protocols; per-stage retention maps; falsification conditions §8.1.

The architectural sibling (ARCH v0.2), read whole. O: auditable foreclosure (defined against the impossibility of a non-foreclosing classifier), five features, implementation strategies, three specifications. D: noncoverage estimation is not novelty detection; what none of the architectures address; feasibility not established.

The Endogenous Sophon v0.3 (restoration pass), its body read whole, the appended witnesses W04–W07 read in part. D: the inversion thesis (frontier experimental HEP become an ML discipline in its operational core), authority without facility, the partial-feedback-pathway formulation of model collapse, the §3.5 precision that the dominant discard is the L1 menu. O: endogenous sophon. R: Zenodo termination and LHC trigger as the same architecture at different budgets. Carried as contested against #934.

The Endogenous Sophon v0.2, the version #935 records as over-corrected; read at its abstract and §7 findings, its body otherwise parallel to #935. Admitted because its findings state the central claims at a different grade: empirical faculty 'inseparable from' machine-mediated selection; authority without integrated self-audit, with local self-knowledge of failure modes acknowledged in the literature; Zenodo and the trigger as one foreclosure topology and explicitly not the same institution or object; the retained fraction with 'does not demonstrate wrongdoing'. The two versions are carried as contested within the pool.

SIGAGNOSTIC disambiguation packet, read through §4. D/O: signal-template agnosticism (interface property) against model independence (distributional property, unmeasured at the deployed L1 triggers); the observed one-directional interchange in summaries; the disambiguation rule; its own limit (no claim the triggers are invalid).

observations: The 22 D deposits of the string pass reduce by reading to one programme in four parts: the June 2026 family (#931–#935), the August disambiguation packet and measurement battery (#1436, #1449, #1455, #1456), the August–September selection-metrology suite (#1450, #1452–#1454, #1558), and two deposits that restate or apply it (#1427, #1611).

The archive's line is narrower than the field's entity. The field ranges over fault diagnostics, beam tuning, errant-beam prediction and anomaly identification at accelerator facilities (CEBAF, SNS, APS, LANSCE); the archive's claims are almost all about learned event selection at the trigger (CMS, ATLAS, LHCb, Belle II, CBM). Nothing admitted is about RF-cavity fault classification, beam tuning or errant-beam prediction.

Contested within the pool: (a) whether collapse is occurring: the W2 witness inside #932 says it is here and operating; the synthesis (#932), the operative paper (#931), W3, #1450, #1452, #1454, #1558 and #1611 mark it unmeasured or not established. (b) The inversion and its diagnosis: #935 restores 'become a machine learning discipline' and 'authority without facility'; #934 states 'inseparable from' and 'authority without integrated self-audit', acknowledging local self-knowledge in the literature, as #931 §1.2 and #1449 §2 also do. (c) Zenodo and the trigger: 'the same architecture at different budgets' (#935) against 'not the same institution … the same foreclosure topology' (#934); #1611 adds that the analogy carries no evidentiary force from the shared institution. (d) The term: #1436 sets a rule that agnosticism must not be rendered as model independence; #1454 says it should not attempt to police the term.
